text:
Jesper Boqvist has 5 goals in 15 games back in New Jersey, where his NHL career started. Last season, with Florida, he scored 4 in 73. That tells you the story: a Cup winner from 2025 who came home, and is finishing at a rate (23.8%) that rarely lasts.

His chances are better than last year, 0.98 individual expected goals per 60 minutes against 0.51. Some of the jump is real. Most of the goal total isn't: 5 goals on 2.94 expected. The Devils take 59% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice at five on five, but that's the team's level, not something he adds.

Evolving-Hockey's note from last season was blunt: offense isn't his game, with his team creating fewer chances with him on (bottom 6%). He plays 12 minutes a night on a deep 12-5 team, which is the right role. He's 28, a 2017 second-round pick from Brynas. Our projection says about 14 goals for the season. If he gets there, it'll be his best year since his first stint in New Jersey. Enjoy it, but don't expect the shooting to hold.
headline: Boqvist is shooting the lights out
